integrity: All infinite-quantifier claims are supported by the stated finite-dimensional symbolic proof; 900 deterministic numerical checks are auxiliary only.
scientific_limitations: The exact spectral formula concerns two positive rank-one inputs with third input zero; the sharp regularization threshold concerns equal-amplitude rank-one orthogonal projections only. It makes no claim for arbitrary matrix triples or unequal amplitudes. A wider historical-priority risk remains; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp rank-one positivity defect of the three-matrix trace-class mixing operation
